svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Block 36 x 140 x 12 mm with four pockets 32.4 mm across and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 deep on a 34 mm pitch; 2 mm floor under each pocket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 3.4 mm screw holes between the middle pockets for the bay floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: screwed to the bay floor against the end wall; the four cells

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stand in the pockets, the BMS sits on top of them, and a hook and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: loop strap holds the pack down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each cell drops in without force and does not rattle.
